## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] The Compass settings snapshot distinguishes Number of Preview Documents (output documents shown; default 10) from Limit (documents passed to $group, $bucket, and $bucketAuto; default 100,000). The latter is preview-only and is not applied when the pipeline is run. These are separate controls, so raising the displayed-document count does not raise the documented grouping-input cap. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/agg-pipeline-builder/aggregation-pipeline-builder-settings.md · keywords: Compass aggregation preview sampling versus full pipeline execution
- [statement] A firsthand July 8, 2018 walkthrough explicitly using Compass 1.14.5 places its 100,000-document Sample Mode limit before $group, $bucket and $bucketAuto. This independently corroborates historical input-limit placement, without establishing the current interface or default. (low confidence) — https://refresher10.blogspot.com/2018/07/ · keywords: Compass aggregation preview sampling versus full pipeline execution
- [statement] An explicitly authored $limit before $group restricts the inputs that contribute to each group; a $limit after $group restricts the number of group documents returned. Removing Compass's preview-only cap by running the pipeline does not remove an explicit $limit written into that pipeline. Diagnose a truncated count by checking both the preview input setting and the authored stage order. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/agg-pipeline-builder/aggregation-pipeline-builder-settings.md · keywords: Compass aggregation preview sampling versus full pipeline execution · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/group.md, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/limit.md

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] COMPASS-10104 identifies Compass 1.48.2 and reports different grouped counts between stage previews and VS Code execution. The reporter acknowledges the preview-only 100,000 input limit and requests clearer stage warnings. This is a user report, not proof of incorrect server aggregation. (low confidence) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/COMPASS-10104 · keywords: Compass aggregation preview sampling versus full pipeline execution
- [statement] A September 2022 community-thread reproduction counted 200,000 documents correctly with MongoDB 6.0.1 and a $group/$sum pipeline; the later response explained Compass's configurable 100,000-document Sample Mode limit. This historical example scopes the apparent ceiling to the builder context rather than establishing a universal 100,000-document server aggregation limit. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/community/forums/t/aggregation-group-by-count-sum-maxed-at-100k-count/189661 · keywords: Compass aggregation preview sampling versus full pipeline execution · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/agg-pipeline-builder/aggregation-pipeline-builder-settings.md
- [statement] The preview input cap can change computed group results, rather than merely hide some output rows. MongoDB documents that lower input limits improve runtime but can omit documents; COMPASS-9826 identifies the number of documents consumed by blocking stages such as $group as a common cause of preview-versus-execution differences. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/agg-pipeline-builder/aggregation-pipeline-builder-settings.md · keywords: Compass aggregation preview sampling versus full pipeline execution · also: https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/COMPASS-9826

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Illustrative consequence, derived from the documented input cap and $group semantics: if 200,000 documents would reach {$group:{_id:null,n:{$sum:1}}}, a preview capped at 100,000 group inputs can display a single result with n=100000, whereas executing the same pipeline without that preview cap counts 200,000. One displayed output document does not mean that every intended input document contributed to its value. This is a semantic example, not a test performed in this research. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/compass/agg-pipeline-builder/aggregation-pipeline-builder-settings.md · keywords: Compass aggregation preview sampling versus full pipeline execution · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/group.md, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/limit.md
